title: How Do Plants Clean the Air?
description:
The Willow Tree That Was Made of Air
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VbPubYd6Fbs

A sprig of mint repaired the air. Joseph Priestley burned a candle in a sealed jar until the flame died. Ten days after he added the mint, a candle burned in that same air.

Sources: Joseph Priestley, "Observations on Different Kinds of Air", Philosophical Transactions 62 (1772).

Pictures: illustrated scenes alongside the spoken experiment. Facts: the ten days and the mint are Priestley's 1771 trial, checked against the source above.
